projects.title: Portfolio Optimizer
projects.description: This app lets users enter stocks or ETFs and build an optimized portfolio using historical return, volatility, covariance, and Sharpe ratio logic. It compares optimized allocations against simple benchmarks and shows allocation charts, equity curves, drawdowns, and correlations.

projects.title: Factor Investing Backtester
projects.description: This app ranks stocks using factor-style signals such as momentum, volatility, and reversal. It converts those rankings into a portfolio and backtests how the factor strategy performs over time.

projects.title: Risk Parity Portfolio
projects.description: This app creates a risk parity-style portfolio using inverse-volatility weighting. Instead of assigning the same dollar amount to each asset, it gives smaller weights to higher-volatility assets and larger weights to lower-volatility assets.

projects.title: Retirement Monte Carlo
projects.description: This app simulates thousands of possible future portfolio paths using expected return, volatility, contributions, withdrawals, and time horizon. It shows the range of possible outcomes and the probability of ending with positive wealth.

projects.title: Options Pricing Engine
projects.description: This app prices call and put options using the Black-Scholes model. It also calculates Greeks such as Delta, Gamma, Vega, and Theta and displays option payoff charts.

projects.title: Var Expected Shortfall Dashboard
projects.description: This app calculates portfolio risk using historical VaR, parametric VaR, and Expected Shortfall. It visualizes return distributions, loss thresholds, drawdowns, and risk metrics.

projects.title: Yield Curve Recession Indicator
projects.description: This app analyzes yield-curve and duration-style signals using liquid market proxies. It creates a macro risk dashboard and tests simple risk-on versus risk-off allocation rules.

projects.title: Credit Risk Scoring Model
projects.description: This app creates a market-based credit risk score using volatility, momentum, and drawdown features. It ranks companies into risk bands and helps identify stronger or weaker credit profiles.

projects.title: Pairs Trading Stat Arb
projects.description: This app analyzes two related securities, estimates a hedge ratio, builds a spread, and tests a z-score mean-reversion strategy. It includes spread charts and backtest metrics.

projects.title: Earnings Surprise Alpha Model
projects.description: This app uses large price gaps as a free-data proxy for earnings surprise events and tests whether post-event drift can be turned into an alpha strategy.

projects.title: Sec 10k Nlp Risk Analyzer
projects.description: This app analyzes pasted SEC filing text and measures risk language, uncertainty language, positive language, and sentiment. It converts unstructured text into interpretable risk metrics.

projects.title: Black Litterman Allocation
projects.description: This app combines market-implied returns with user-defined views to create a professional asset allocation. It compares implied returns, posterior returns, and final portfolio weights.

projects.title: Fixed Income Duration Toolkit
projects.description: This app prices a bond using coupon rate, yield, maturity, coupon frequency, and face value. It calculates modified duration, convexity, and the bond price-yield relationship.

projects.title: Volatility Forecasting Model
projects.description: This app compares realized volatility and EWMA volatility forecasts. It also shows how volatility forecasts can be used to build a volatility-targeted strategy.

projects.title: Market Regime Detection
projects.description: This app classifies market environments using return, volatility, trend, and drawdown features. It uses clustering to identify different regimes such as risk-on, neutral, and risk-off periods.

projects.title: Limit Order Book Simulator
projects.description: This app simulates a simplified limit order book with bid prices, ask prices, market depth, order size, average fill price, and slippage.

projects.title: Machine Learning Stock Return Prediction
projects.description: This app predicts forward stock returns using lagged technical and cross-sectional features. It includes walk-forward validation, information coefficient analysis, feature importance, strategy construction, and backtesting.

projects.title: Etf Holdings Factor Exposure
projects.description: This app analyzes ETF holdings from pasted holdings data. It calculates sector exposure, top holdings, and concentration using metrics such as the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index.

projects.title: Merger Arbitrage Spread Tracker
projects.description: This app models a merger arbitrage trade using current target price, deal price, break price, days to close, and probability of completion. It calculates deal spread, annualized spread, break loss, and expected return.
